rich-man-lazarus-02.title: Lazarus at the gate
rich-man-lazarus-02.alt: A thin gray-haired man in torn clothing sits barefoot against a closed gate, with sores on his limbs; one dog licks his lower leg while another lies beside him.
rich-man-lazarus-02.caption: Lazarus lies at the rich man's gate, covered with sores and longing for what falls from the table. Even the dogs come and lick his sores, underscoring the need beside the rich man's abundance.
